text:
alex: heads-up: starting soft cutover checkpoint for engine-v2.3 on night cluster in 20m. keeping canary at 5%

maria: noted. what's the exact rollback criteria?

alex: primary: >1.5x p95 latency vs baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR error-rate spike >0.8% request-level for 2m. secondary: kv-cache miss rate >30% sustained 5m.

jun: can we add a behavioral regression check for top-10 prompts we use in smoke? last time a quant tweak changed punctuation probability.

alex: yes, we'll run evalset A (10 prompts) after canary step and before bump to 25%. if bleu/avg-token-match drops >4% we halt.

rahul: deploybot: preparing bundle engine-v2.3-quant-20240312. staging images pushed to gcr, tag: v2.3-candidate.

deploybot: build finished: engine-v2.3-quant-20240312 (sha: ab12f3). smoke passed on staging. rolling canary to 5% in us-west-2 in 5m. :rocket:

sam: quick note — release notes draft has an entry about "kernel ABI surface expansion" but docs team flagged missing migration steps for on-prem. pinging @maria to add.

maria: on it. adding migration steps + sample systemd unit diff. will push to the release-notes doc in 10m.

eng-oncall-bot: alert: us-west-2 canary: p95 increased by 22% relative to baseline at 1714008012.

alex: seeing that too. holding canary at 5% while we probe. rolling back the canary flag to previous kernel build for the impacted hosts in the pool.

jun: logs show a new kernel matmul path falling back with extra memcpy for short sequences. can we toggle the matmul short-path gate?

alex: yes. flipping gate and re-issuing config patch now.

deploybot: config patch applied. re-evaluating canary. smoke evalset A started.

eng-oncall-bot: smoke eval complete: avg-token-match within 0.6% of baseline, p95 back to 6% delta. no error spike.

alex: okay good. we'll let canary run another 20m and then bump to 25% if stable. leaving a note in the release notes: "soft-cutover required matmul short-path gate toggle; patch applied during canary."

maria: added on-prem migration steps and the soft-cutover note. also added an ops checklist entry to pin older engine if rollback needed.

rahul: can someone confirm SLA impact window for this bump? product asked for exact minutes.

alex: we had a 12-minute window of elevated p95 during the initial ramp; alert triggered at +22% for ~3m before gate flip; total mitigation time ~8m. I'll add a short timeline to the incident note.

sam: thanks. small ask: include the exact deploybot commands used for rollback in the postmortem so infra can reproduce in on-prem.

alex: will paste commands and the exact tag names. also adding the smoke eval prompts and baseline hashes.

jun: can we make the matmul short-path gate default to off for next few builds until we have better perf telemetry?

alex: agree. adding a follow-up ticket to runtime backlog: gate-default-disable + perf-sampling for short sequences.

maria: all set on docs. tagging support and sales for heads-up. :thumbsup:

deploybot: canary stabilized at 5% for 20m, proceeding to 25% in 10m unless any objections.

alex: no objections. leaving channel for handoff notes and postmortem items.

sam: thanks all. will compile release-note final and send to comms in 30m.

rahul: closing loop: please add a TL;DR in the release note: "soft cutover required temporary matmul gate toggle; no customer-facing data loss; brief latency blip mitigated."

maria: added TL;DR. good run.
